verdict.rationale: Runloop's Devboxes and benchmark job system let agents run untended in provisioned sandboxes (e.g., 'Runloop handle everything: provisioning devboxes, running agents, scoring results') which supports autonomous background execution, but there is no documented scheduling, triggers, or cron-like automation-setup feature for general background tasks. missing for 10: explicit scheduling/trigger mechanisms, persistent background job management outside benchmarks, evidence of long-running unattended agent workflows beyond benchmark runs.
